title: 9 Lies About Brotherhood a Godly Man Has to Unlearn
caption:
Not online. Not a podcast. Not a Discord. Two or three actual guys who have his number, know his sin, and show up.

Most men never get there because of what they've quietly assumed about brotherhood along the way.

9 lies to unlearn: a real brother doesn't need to be told he's needed, group chat activity counts as showing up, he'll open up once things get bad enough, iron sharpens iron happens by accident, checking on him after the funeral is enough, and four more.

Which one hits closest to home? Tell a brother.
